name: regina_feedback_closure
cadence_note: One-time, ~10-15 contacts over 3 weeks. Ships strategy-only in R6: contacts.has_private_feedback is 0 for all rows until the definition + backfill sub-task lands (R6.5+).
description: Close the loop with guests who left private feedback. Channel is whatever Regina can reach them on (email, phone, or Airbnb thread); the provenance hard rule routes channel at draft time.
prompt_context: This guest left private feedback after their stay. Acknowledge what they shared (the dossier has the gist), describe a specific change you've made or are making in response, and thank them. No ask. Keep under 100 words. Sign as Sarah.
